title: Recognizing Study Lineage Is Not Enough: Over-Crediting Same-Trial Evidence in LLM-Based Medical Verification
abstract: arXiv:2610.23721v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Publication count is not study count. A model can identify shared trial lineage correctly in a direct task yet over-credit a second publication from the same trial when aggregating evidence. We evaluate this behavior in medical LLM verification using 14 source-audited clinical families and five model conditions. The families span provenance, clinical applicability, result direction, and composition; the provenance families provide the direct lineage tests. Recognition and aggregation are separate stateless calls, and repeated calls assess within-input stability. Across all three original provenance families, GPT-5.5 identifies the independent update in 10/10 recognition calls per family but over-credits the same-trial report in 5/5 separate aggregation calls per family. Selected Qwen3-4B and Ministral-3-8B conditions show the same cross-task contrast. A study-grouping instruction reduces GPT-5.5 over-credit from 4/5 to 0/5 in each later

translated_title: 识别研究谱系并不足够：基于大语言模型的医学验证中对同试验证据的过度采信
translated_abstract: 发表数量不等于研究数量。模型可以在直接任务中正确识别共享的试验谱系，但在聚合证据时却会过度采信来自同一试验的第二篇发表文献。我们使用14个经过来源审计的临床文献族和五种模型条件，在医学大语言模型验证中评估了这一行为。这些文献族涵盖来源溯源性、临床适用性、结果方向和组成结构；其中来源溯源性文献族提供了直接的谱系测试。识别和聚合是相互分离的无状态调用，重复调用用于评估同一输入内的稳定性。在所有三个原始来源溯源性文献族中，GPT-5.5在每个族的全部10次识别调用中都能识别出独立更新，但在每个族全部5次单独的聚合调用中都过度采信了同一试验的报告。选定的Qwen3-4B和Ministral-3-8B模型条件也显示出相同的跨任务对比。一项研究分组指令将GPT-5.5在后续测试中的过度采信从4/5降至0/5
tldr: 大语言模型虽能在直接任务中正确识别临床试验的谱系关系，但在证据聚合时仍会过度采信同一试验的多篇发表文献而高估证据强度，而简单的分组指令可显著缓解这一问题。
en_tdlr: Although LLMs correctly recognize shared trial lineage in direct recognition tasks, they still over-credit duplicate publications from the same trial when aggregating evidence, a bias that a simple study-grouping instruction can substantially mitigate.
